q: Canada is the second largest country on earth, with how many square kilometres?
zq: 加拿大是地球第二大國家，面積多少平方公里？
e: Three oceans line its frontiers: Pacific, Atlantic and Arctic.
ze: 三個大洋環繞：太平洋、大西洋、北冰洋。

q: About how many people live in Canada, according to the 2021 guide?
zq: 根據 2021 年版指南，加拿大約有多少人口？
e: The guide says about 34 million; Canada passed 40 million in 2023.
ze: 指南寫約 3,400 萬；加拿大 2023 年已突破 4,000 萬。

q: Which province has its own time zone and is the most easterly point in North America?
zq: 哪個省有自己的時區，也是北美最東端？
e: It was the oldest colony of the British Empire.
ze: 它曾是大英帝國最古老的殖民地。

q: Which province is Canada's main producer of pulp and paper and its largest producer of hydro-electricity?
zq: 哪個省是加拿大主要的紙漿和紙張生產地，也是最大的水力發電生產者？
e: Nearly eight million people live in Quebec, mostly along the St. Lawrence River.
ze: 將近八百萬人住在魁北克，多沿聖羅倫斯河。

q: Which province has the largest French-speaking population outside Quebec?
zq: 哪個省擁有魁北克以外最多的法語人口？
e: Ontario's people make up more than one-third of Canadians.
ze: 安大略人口占加拿大三分之一以上。

q: What is the most famous street intersection in Canada, according to the guide?
zq: 根據指南，加拿大最著名的十字路口是哪裡？
zo: 溫尼伯的波蒂奇大道與緬街
羅布森街與格蘭維爾街
斯帕克斯街與埃爾金街
e: Winnipeg's French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada's largest Francophone community.
ze: 溫尼伯的法語區聖博尼法斯有加拿大西部最大的法語社群。

q: Which province has the largest Aboriginal population of any province, at over 15%?
zq: 哪個省的原住民人口比例在各省中最高，超過 15%？
e: Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture.
ze: 曼尼托巴也是烏克蘭文化的重要中心。

q: Which two resources does Saskatchewan have the world's richest deposits of?
zq: 薩克其萬擁有世界上最豐富的哪兩種礦藏？
e: Saskatchewan has 40% of the arable land in Canada.
ze: 薩克其萬擁有加拿大 40% 的可耕地。

q: Alberta and Lake Louise were both named after whom?
zq: 亞伯達省和露易絲湖都以誰命名？
o: Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria
zo: 維多利亞女王的第四個女兒露易絲・卡洛琳・亞伯達公主
e: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff, established in 1885.
ze: 亞伯達有五個國家公園，包括 1885 年設立的班夫。

q: About half of all the goods produced in British Columbia are what?
zq: 卑詩省生產的商品約有一半是什麼？
e: B.C. has the most valuable forestry industry in Canada and about 600 provincial parks.
ze: 卑詩省有加拿大最有價值的林業和約 600 個省立公園。

q: What fraction of Canada's land mass do the three territories contain?
zq: 三個地區占加拿大陸地面積的多少？
e: But they have a population of only 100,000.
ze: 但人口只有十萬。

q: What is the Mackenzie River?
zq: 馬更些河是什麼？
o: The second-longest river system in North America after the Mississippi
zo: 北美僅次於密西西比河的第二長河流系統
e: At 4,200 km it drains 1.8 million square kilometres.
ze: 長 4,200 公里，流域 180 萬平方公里。

q: Whose poetry celebrated the Yukon Gold Rush of the 1890s?
zq: 誰的詩歌歌頌了 1890 年代的育空淘金熱？
e: The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened in 1900.
ze: 白隘口與育空鐵路 1900 年通車。

q: What percentage of Nunavut's population is Inuit?
zq: 努納福特人口有百分之多少是因紐特人？
e: Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.
ze: 因紐特語是官方語言，也是學校的第一語言。

q: Who are the Canadian Rangers?
zq: 加拿大巡邏隊是誰？
o: Part of the Canadian Forces Reserves who patrol the North and keep the flag flying in the Arctic
zo: 加拿大軍隊後備部隊的一部分，巡邏北方、讓國旗在北極飄揚
e: They travel by snowmobile in winter and all-terrain vehicles in summer.
ze: 他們冬天騎雪上摩托車、夏天駕全地形車。

q: Which region is known as the industrial and manufacturing heartland of Canada?
zq: 哪個區域被稱為加拿大的工業和製造業心臟地帶？
zo: 中部加拿大（魁北克南部與安大略）
e: Ontario and Quebec produce more than three-quarters of all Canadian manufactured goods.
ze: 安大略和魁北克生產四分之三以上的加拿大製造品。

q: How long do you have to write the citizenship test?
zq: 公民考試的作答時間有多長？
e: 20 questions in 30 minutes; 15 correct to pass.
ze: 30 分鐘 20 題，答對 15 題通過。

q: In which languages can you take the citizenship test?
zq: 公民考試可以用哪些語言？
e: The test is in one of Canada's two official languages.
ze: 考試用加拿大兩種官方語言之一。

q: ONTARIO: Where is the Ontario legislature located?
zq: 安大略省題：安大略省議會在哪裡？
e: Ontario's Legislative Assembly sits at Queen's Park in Toronto.
ze: 安大略立法議會位於多倫多皇后公園。

q: ONTARIO: Which of the following is a provincial responsibility that Ontario handles?
zq: 安大略省題：下列哪一項是安大略負責的省級職責？
e: Ontario also has its own provincial police force, the OPP.
ze: 安大略也有自己的省警察 OPP。

q: ONTARIO: What is the name of the Ontario provincial police force?
zq: 安大略省題：安大略省警察的名稱是什麼？
e: Only Ontario and Quebec have provincial police forces.
ze: 只有安大略和魁北克有省警察。

q: ONTARIO: Which is the largest city in Ontario and in Canada?
zq: 安大略省題：安大略和加拿大最大的城市是哪裡？
e: Toronto is also Canada's main financial centre.
ze: 多倫多也是加拿大主要的金融中心。

q: ONTARIO: The Niagara region of Ontario is known for what?
zq: 安大略省題：安大略的尼加拉地區以什麼聞名？
e: Ontario farmers also raise dairy and beef cattle, poultry, vegetables and grain.
ze: 安大略農民也養乳牛、肉牛、家禽，種蔬菜和穀物。

q: ONTARIO: Which Great Lake does NOT border Ontario?
zq: 安大略省題：哪個大湖不與安大略接壤？
e: Lake Michigan is in the U.S.A.; Lake Superior is the largest freshwater lake in the world.
ze: 密西根湖在美國；蘇必略湖是世界最大淡水湖。

q: ONTARIO: Who founded Ontario, according to the guide?
zq: 安大略省題：根據指南，安大略由誰建立？
e: Ontario was Upper Canada, mainly Loyalist, Protestant and English-speaking.
ze: 安大略前身是上加拿大，以效忠派、新教徒和英語人口為主。

q: ONTARIO: What is the national capital, located in Ontario?
zq: 安大略省題：位於安大略的國家首都是哪裡？
e: Ottawa, on the Ottawa River, was chosen by Queen Victoria in 1857.
ze: 渥太華河畔的渥太華由維多利亞女王在 1857 年選定。

q: ONTARIO: Which party does Premier Doug Ford lead (as of 2026)?
zq: 安大略省題：省長 Doug Ford 領導哪個政黨（2026 年）？
e: Confirm the current Premier and party on ontario.ca before your test.
ze: 考前到 ontario.ca 確認現任省長與政黨。

q: ONTARIO: What is the name of your provincial electoral district and representative?
zq: 安大略省題：你的省選區和省議員叫什麼？
o: It depends on where you live; look it up at elections.on.ca by postal code
zo: 要看你住哪裡；到 elections.on.ca 用郵遞區號查
e: Write down your MPP (provincial) and MP (federal) before the test.
ze: 考前寫下你的省議員 MPP 和聯邦議員 MP。

q: ONTARIO: Approximately what share of Canadians live in Ontario?
zq: 安大略省題：大約多少比例的加拿大人住在安大略？
e: At more than 12 million (2021 guide), Ontario has the largest population of any province.
ze: 2021 年版寫超過 1,200 萬，是人口最多的省。

q: What is the passing score on the citizenship test?
zq: 公民考試的及格分數是多少？
e: 15 correct answers out of 20, that is 75%.

q: What types of questions are on the citizenship test?
zq: 公民考試有哪些題型？
e: All questions are based on the study guide.
ze: 所有題目都根據學習指南出題。
